sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 10050273 (catx.py: 12 RV electric sites + 8 overflow sites)

values.note: 2026 rate table: 'Campsite RV' (the 12 catalogued 30-amp sites) $25; overflow sites $15 (catalogued for vehicles to 15 ft, so not counted as the base); a 'Campsite' rate of $18 exists in the table but no catalogued site carries it.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10050273/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-01 to 09-30: 'Campsite RV' RV ELECTRIC 25, 'Campsite' STANDARD ELECTRIC 18, 'Overflow' STANDARD NONELECTRIC 15; same 2025-2028) + catalog (overflow sites max vehicle length 15), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10050273 ('Each of the 13 designated campsites has electrical hookups available') + catalog (all 12 RV ELECTRIC sites 'Electric Hookup: 30'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 13 designated electric sites plus an overflow section (8 sites, some with tables and fire rings). Catalog: 6 pull-through and 6 back-in electric sites, most rated to 45 ft.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10050273 ('The campground features 13 campsites with electrical hook-ups as well as an overflow section') + catalog (max vehicle length 45 on 10 sites; 6 'Pull-through'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Water spigots throughout. The dump station is about 5 miles away, near the Downstream Campground.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10050273 ('Shower facilities with flush toilets are found within the campground as well as a vault toilet. There are water spigots available throughout the campground and a dump station is located approximately 5 miles away near the Downstream Campground.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Same-day only: 'Reservations are only allowed on the day of arrival' - the former first-come campground now has you claim a site online on arrival day, for up to 14 nights. Not staffed by gate attendants; check in with the camp host or by text. Sites must be occupied the day of arrival and every night. 14 nights in any rolling 30 days.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10050273 (overview 'Reservations are only allowed on the day of arrival.', 'West End Tent and Trailer was historically a first come first serve campground. We have mirrored this with the ability to claim your campsite with an online reservation. You can only claim a campsite today for up to 14 nights from today. No advanced reservations are allowed.'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 nights Rolling 30 Days), read 2026-10-22

note: USACE Fort Peck Project campground on a hill on the north shore of Fort Peck Lake, near the town of Fort Peck; most sites have at least a partial lake view. Quieter than the main (Downstream) campground, with two boat ramps within 2 mi. --Claude
summary: Recreation.gov (USACE Fort Peck Project, same-day online claim only): confirmed 13 electric sites, 30-amp, 45-ft max, showers/flush/vault toilets, drinking water, rec.gov booking. Changed fees 15-25 -> 25/25 (the $15 is the overflow area, catalogued to 15 ft) and dump true -> false (dump station ~5 mi away). Added pull-throughs, same-day window, 14-night limit. Season not stated (the May-Sep rate season is not a season statement). Note corrected (it claimed an on-site dump) and trimmed of restated values.
